page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr6.2xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 4 physical Intel Xeon 8269CY cores running at 3.1 GHz. The architecture is x86_64, supported by 64.0 GB of RAM, which provides a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. The instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data places this instance consistently in the average performance tier across standard compute and memory workloads. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance is recorded at 1436.99, while multi-core performance reaches 7661.86. Memory bandwidth tests show 427.43 GB/sec for cached small-block reads, dropping to 50.86 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 38.65 GB/sec for write operations. In database operations, the instance handles 7.55 million Redis SET operations per second and achieves a PassMark database score of 3011.35.

A key tradeoff is the lack of local storage and GPU acceleration, which limits its utility for high-throughput local disk operations and heavy machine learning workloads. This is reflected in LLM inference benchmarks, where the instance achieves a weak 6.44 tokens/sec for text generation on a medium 7B model. However, the high memory density and solid memory bandwidth make it suitable for memory-intensive workloads such as in-memory databases, caching layers, and general-purpose enterprise applications that do not require local NVMe storage.
